template_name: Co-Occurring AOD, Mental Health & DFV Case Plan Template

sequencing_phases.description: Must begin immediately, before or concurrent with treatment enrollment. Not gated behind AOD/MH treatment completion.
AOD and mental health treatment run concurrently, not sequentially. Do not require AOD completion before starting trauma-informed MH work.
Begins once Phase 1 safety goals are met and Phase 2 shows sustained improvement across two or more timepoints with no new critical overrides.

protective_parent_track.description: Victim-survivor / protective parent goals. Never combined with perpetrator track.

perpetrator_track.description: Perpetrator accountability goals. Scored, case-planned, and reviewed entirely separately from the protective parent track. Never appears on the protective parent's case plan document.

shared_functional_track.description: AOD, mental health, and coordination goals. Individually assigned per parent/caregiver being assessed; not shared as a single goal across two adults.

goal_types.goal_label: Maintain and update dynamic safety plan
Monitor compliance with any active protection order
Enroll and actively engage in AOD treatment
Maintain relapse management plan tied directly to safety plan
Engage in trauma-informed mental health treatment concurrent with AOD support
Demonstrate ability to respond to child distress
Identify and strengthen non-offending support network
Enroll and attend perpetrator behaviour change program
Behaviour change verified independently, not by self-report alone
Establish information-sharing agreement across DFV, AOD, and MH providers

critical_override_response_rules.rule: Any active critical override forces creation of a Phase 1 safety review task within 48 hours, regardless of which domain triggered it.
PA3_HIGH override never generates or modifies a goal on the protective_parent_track.
